note: Every knip finding this repo carried on 2026-09-10: 120 entries — 1 dependency, 5 devDependencies, 55 exports, 31 files, 25 types, 3 unlisted. Re-measured the same day when Task 17 (`smoke`) made `@playwright/test` a real root devDependency: the `unlisted|scripts/verify/registry.mjs|@playwright/test` entry is now STALE (knip no longer reports it) and was deleted per this ratchet's own bidirectional rule, leaving 119 entries — 1 dependency, 5 devDependencies, 55 exports, 31 files, 25 types, 2 unlisted. Re-measured again on the same day when Task 18 added .claude/hooks/edit-lint.mjs and .claude/hooks/batch-typecheck.mjs: knip's default root-workspace scan (the two custom `workspaces` entries in knip.json cover only backend/frontend, so an unconfigured root workspace still applies knip's own default project glob to everything else, .claude/hooks included) flags both as unused files, since neither is statically imported or named in any package.json script — only .claude/settings.json's hook command line invokes them, a config-driven path knip cannot follow, the same class of blind spot as the migration and db-spec entries already on this baseline. That is 121 entries — 1 dependency, 5 devDependencies, 55 exports, 33 files, 25 types, 2 unlisted. Each reason was written after reading the finding's actual code (grep/read, cited inline), never inferred from the shape of the key. Several are the SAME underlying story recorded at more than one key: a barrel re-export unreachable because every real consumer imports the concrete module directly (shared/api/index.ts's whole surface, features/auth's `login`, settle-payout's and void-document's mutation hooks, shared/lib/theme's ThemePreference type), a vendored shadcn/radix primitive whose file is reachable but one specific sub-export is not (alert-dialog/dialog/table/tabs/badge/button/tooltip/toast), a *.db-spec.ts file (or its db-harness.ts helper) that backend/jest.db.config.js runs directly but knip's Jest plugin cannot see because its default spec/test glob requires a literal dot before 'spec'/'test' and never matches the hyphenated '-db-spec.ts' suffix, a TypeORM migration discovered by the runner via a glob rather than a static import, or an independently-duplicated type/helper (Paginated<T> redeclared in six model files, DocumentFilter in two, UserRole in two, documentParams in two) where only one copy's re-export path is the one real callers actually use. FOURTEEN entries are exactly the documented-deliberate decisions frontend/CLAUDE.md names, in three groups: (1) shared/lib/form-draft's own file finding (1 entry) — 'infrastructure, carried over from the boilerplate ... nothing consumes it yet ... don't delete it as dead code'; (2) the Kit-hygiene note's named starter-UI-primitives list, which accounts for 8 file findings (animated-number, checkbox, drawer, dropdown-menu, filter-section, progress, radio-group, select) plus the vaul dependency finding that traces to drawer.tsx's own import (9 entries) — 'candidates for deletion in a dedicated cleanup, not for silent reuse'; and (3) the Server-state section's note on entities/user's useUpdateMeMutation, 'kept as the pattern reference, not dead code to delete' (4 entries: the function and its UpdateMeInput type, each at both its origin file and its barrel re-export). The remaining 106 entries are genuinely unexplained-elsewhere findings, each read and reasoned individually — not invented deliberate decisions. None of this was deleted: backend/src and frontend/src are out of scope for this task. This ratchet is two-directional: a new finding not listed here fails scripts/verify/ratchets/dead-exports.mjs, and a listed entry knip no longer reports also fails it — this file may only shrink or be re-dated by a reviewed change, never grow by drift.
